args.text: To wash your denim jeans, wash them rarely and inside out in cold water to prevent the color from fading [fabric-care#4]. You should avoid using a tumble dryer and instead hang them to dry; for small marks, it is better to spot clean them rather than washing the entire pair [fabric-care#4]. Regarding wedding etiquette, you should avoid wearing white to a wedding as a guest [dress-codes#5].
